text: Exposes an OpenAI-compatible API usable with any OpenAI SDK/client
quote: LocalAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.

text: Supports the Anthropic Messages API for compatibility with Claude clients
quote: LocalAI supports the Anthropic Messages API, which is compatible with Claude clients.

text: Also supports the Open Responses API in addition to OpenAI/Anthropic formats
quote: LocalAI also supports the **Anthropic Messages API**, the **Open Responses API**, and more.

text: Autoparser automatically detects tool-call format for any tool-trained GGUF model with no config needed
quote: No configuration required - the autoparser detects the tool call format for any ggml/gguf model that was trained with tool support.

text: Supports OpenAI functions/tools API across multiple backends
quote: LocalAI supports running the OpenAI functions and tools API across multiple backends.

text: Supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect models to external tools/services
quote: LocalAI now supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling powerful agentic capabilities by connecting AI models to external tools and services.

text: Lets you create and manage AI agents with MCP tool support
quote: Create and manage AI agents with MCP tool support

text: MCP servers can be attached directly to an agent, independent of the underlying model
quote: LocalAI's agents can also attach MCP servers to a single **agent**, independent of the model it runs on.

text: MCP servers are configured via a comma-separated list in agent metadata (metadata.mcp_servers)
quote: Pass a comma-separated list of server names in `metadata.mcp_servers`

text: Built-in model gallery/Discover page lets you install models via the UI
quote: Install models from the built-in gallery (Discover page)

text: CLI command to list available models in the gallery
quote: local-ai models list          # List available models in the gallery

text: Distributed worker nodes with GPUs can self-register with a frontend coordinator for distributed inference
quote: Distributed nodes: Add GPU worker nodes that self-register with a frontend coordinator

text: Multi-user auth mode with admin/user roles, OAuth login, per-user API keys, and usage tracking
quote: User authentication: Run with LOCALAI_AUTH=true for multi-user support with admin/user roles, OAuth login, per-user API keys, and usage tracking.

text: local-ai chat provides a shell agent that reads files and runs commands behind an approval gate
quote: an agent in your own shell. local-ai chat reads your files and runs commands on your machine, behind an approval gate you control.

text: Runs without requiring a GPU
quote: No GPU required.

text: --external-grpc-backends CLI flag lets you point to a local file or remote URL backend
quote: The --external-grpc-backends parameter in the CLI can be used either to specify a local backend (a file) or a remote URL.

text: PRELOAD_MODELS env/flag lets you preload a JSON list of models at startup
quote: PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.

text: Model aliasing lets you assign a simple custom nickname to a complex model name
quote: Model Aliasing: You can now set up model aliases, meaning you can call your favorite complex model name by a simpler, custom nickname.

text: You can edit a previously saved chat prompt/response without re-running the model
quote: To correct an earlier prompt or response without running the model again, hover over the saved message and select Edit.

text: Built-in web interface for chatting, managing model installs, and configuring agents with no extra tools
quote: LocalAI comes with a **built-in web interface** for chatting with models, managing installations, configuring AI agents, and more, with no extra tools needed.

text: Can run models fetched directly from Hugging Face via a URI (e.g. local-ai run huggingface://...)
quote: local-ai run huggingface://TheBloke/phi-2-GGUF/phi-2.Q8_0.gguf

text: Automatically detects GPU capabilities across NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel and downloads the matching backend
quote: LocalAI automatically detects your system's GPU capabilities (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) and downloads the appropriate backend.

text: Single runtime spans text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D and agent workloads
quote: Text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D and agents, from one open runtime.

text: Every feature ships with a fully-tested CPU-only execution path, not a degraded fallback
quote: Every feature ships a CPU path first. That path is tested in CI, on the hardware most people already have, and it is not a degraded fallback.

text: Supports real-time voice conversations: speech in, tool calls, speech out over WebRTC
quote: Speech in, tool calls in the middle, speech out over WebRTC, fast enough to feel like a conversation.
